title: Talons of Terror
overview: Deadly and with sharp claws, vultures, eagles, and hawks are majestic, wild, and mysterious birds that have always filled our imagination as powerful symbols of nature.  Throughout this documentary, follow Fergus Beeley of National Geographic, a passionate bird of prey enthusiast, on an exciting journey from the coast of England to Australia and learn about the evolution of these powerful animals, feared conquerors of the skies...
